lastCompletedStory.title: Require a change/setup context for the Configuration change cue

nextStoryContext: The config cue's pattern in SETUP_CHECKLIST_CUES (src/release/pr-body.ts, last entry) now requires config/configuration to co-occur (anywhere in the \n-joined haystack, either order) with an action verb (new/update/change/edit/add/set) OR a standalone config-artifact token (project.toml, config file/configuration file). No other cue was touched. Two new tests added to the 'composePrBody Setup checklist' describe block in test/release/pr-body.test.ts (negative: incidental 'configuration' mentions; positive: genuine config-change phrasing).
